description: Stores a draft website in the user's Scopeweb portfolio and returns a persistent draft_id and a live preview_url. For when the user wants a page, site or landing draft for a name and none exists yet. Drafts persist across conversations. Content is screened on every version; a flagged draft is still stored, but its preview serves HTTP 451. Cannot spend money.

description.description: One paragraph on what this is

files.description: Site files. index.html required for a browsable preview.

host.description: A domain your account has proven it owns and attached as a draft host (POST /agency-hosts). With label, the draft is also published at https://{label}.{host}, noindex and with no Scopeweb banner. Send host and label together.

label.description: The address on host, for example ninkasi for ninkasi.example.com. 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; names that imitate login, payment or brand pages are refused.

slug.description: Readable word for the preview address. Scopeweb adds a 3-character random tag, so ninkasi is served at https://ninkasi-k7q.scopedraft.dev. 3 to 36 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Optional: derived from name_hint when omitted. Names that imitate login, payment or brand pages are refused.

name: create_draft
